items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And Bunk used to like to drink, you know. And he used to, you know, buy us a little drink.

ctx.x: I asked him which came first.

We had some band, too. Most of our jobs called for white people. We said. We was up three years before we could play for one color people. And the first time we played for color people when Joe Oliver left from the air. You know, the thing I got in there when I was standing right by Joe Oliver with a fellow drumming him, Buddy Sali. Hit him in the eye with a wheel by the hammer. And you know, I thought Joe would be one eye, you know. And he used to have a man, Carol, all them boys. He must have been around about…
I asked you who this Bourne was. That's not Harrison Bourne.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: We were all friends. Bunk used to drive afloat, you know?

ctx.x: I never did play with Bunk. I never did play with Bunk. I never did play with Bunk. You remember Bunk?

Bunk? Bunk? Oh, yeah. I never did play with Bunk. You know what I used to do with Bunk? That's what I told him to play guitar so good. We were all friends. Bunk used to drive afloat, you know? And when Bunk hit off, he used to get back on a party street, you know, in them trunks. And when me and Henry would meet him before he'd get there, and he would buy us a whole lot of beer. Bunk would, you know, feed it. He used to like good if it's Bunk and blow. Yeah. Then Bunk and Johnny and all of them come over to…
When he was out serenading, how much money would he make?
